'''Ratak Raam'luk''' was a [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. Raam'luk served as an Administrative/Personnel Officer, as well as holding a place on the [[Guild Council]], sometime during the tenure of [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] as the Guild's Head.<ref name="Bounty Hunter Code" />

During his time as an Administrative/Personnel Officer, contributed to the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]. Titled "Advantages of Guild Membership", Raam'luk's contribution to the handbook covered all benefits offered to [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] whom held membership in the Guild.<ref name="Bounty Hunter Code" />
